detail: Found by the user. Cause (read from the code): the hover highlight saves an Undo step whenever the item under the cursor changes during a drag (RigPointerArea.qml:388 setOverlayHover -> rig_overlays.js bump()); resizing a picture/text/table hits it constantly. Fix: hover only redraws; a drag-in-progress guard (gestureActive, beginGesture/endGesture) makes each drag one step on release; leader-end unhook joins the release step. New spec 07 S55a; tests count steps from real drags for every gesture kind on both planes.
note: Every drag is one Undo step on release: before 2–8 steps per gesture (21 kinds tested, both planes), after 1; one Undo restores exactly. Also Esc, lost grab, Undo mid-drag, and the ruler's new guide (found by UNDO-T, fixed by the lead).
title: A mouse drag (resize, move, rotate, crop, skew, leader, hotspot, guide, print area) makes many Undo steps; should be one on release
